name: DHL Supply Chain - Whitestown DC - Whitestown IN

fieldNotes.location: IDENTIFICATION UNCERTAIN. Roster lat/lng was geocoded from '5000 Anson Blvd, Whitestown IN' but moved 2755m - a large displacement indicating low geocoding precision. The Anson logistics park (Whitestown, off I-65) contains dozens of near-identical speculative warehouses, several vacant in current imagery; no DHL signage could be confirmed in available Street View (most park-interior panos are June-2019 pre-construction). Audited the building AT the geocoded coordinate (39.9678,-86.3766) as the best-available candidate - it is a front-load warehouse with operational dock activity (trailers backed in), consistent with DHL having occupied 5000 Anson Blvd since Q1 2020.
fieldNotes.building: Single front-load (single-sided) warehouse running SW-NE, ~250m long; dock doors on the NW long face only. SE face borders I-65 with an employee-parking buffer strip and no docks.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled gate or guard booth visible - access is via open driveways within the Anson industrial park (typical of spec buildings). truckGate=false / guardShack=false, but flagged uncertain as the exact building/entry could not be confirmed.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~30-40 dock doors on the single NW face -> banded 25-50; low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: A short row of ~12 drop-yard trailers in the truck court NW of the building.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Whitestown / Anson is an edge-of-metro logistics park surrounded by farmland and I-65; classed Rural per the rubric (small-town industrial leans Rural).
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated ~15 acres for the diagonal building parcel + truck court; the perimeter bounding box overstates the diagonal lot. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.recommendation: Re-verify the exact DHL building among the Anson cluster (DHL also has nearby Whitestown sites at 3930 S 500 E and a Fishback Creek facility). Flag for human review of the facility identification.
